selection.selection: One lowest hash-ranked repository per language in fixed Python/JavaScript/TypeScript/Go order, disjoint repositories; one lowest hash-ranked file per role, 100-3000 tokens. Exclude known held and previously reviewed repository names and supplied aliases. Docs may be another language. These are path-hint candidates, not verified bundles.

lineage.scope: First exact test revision recovered within at most five test-path commits. The complete Python triplet concerns different exercises; failed joins do not prove no common revision exists elsewhere.
lineage.notices: MIT notice retained at each pinned revision; source-use approval remains open.
lineage.alias_scope: GitHub source/fork metadata; graph remains partial. Package-manifest repository URLs alone are not verified aliases.

bundles.triplet_scope: At the first recovered matching test revision, searching at most five test-path commits; failures do not prove no common revision exists elsewhere.

payload.scope: Screen reconstructed test/source/docs/config files. Initial unrelated role samples and license notices are provenance evidence, not proposed training payload. Source family and near-duplicate graph remains partial. No execution, dependency closure or correctness approval.

review.method: Complete static reading of the 19 payload files and retained notices; no source execution or dependency installation. Observations are bounded examples, not population rates.

findings.Python: Four positive-number tests pass the expected number as assertTrue failure message, checking truthiness rather than equality; two type cases assert None. Needs independent output assertions.
findings.JavaScript: One balanced seven-node BFS fixture; implementation dereferences both children without guards, so single-node and sparse trees are unsupported. Static counterexamples, not execution results.
findings.TypeScript: Queue exercise with six test cases and resolved local type import; no independent correctness or practical repository-repair evidence.
findings.Go: MinInt(1,0) returns 0 by inspection but the supplied test expects 1. Contradictory test oracle despite no content flag.

review.decision: Admit none. Stop selecting bundles on repository co-presence alone. Require semantic linkage, practical task coverage, independent oracles and source/family eligibility before execution or training.

limits: Conservative exact/fragment matches are not proof of semantic contamination; no hits are not proof of cleanliness.
All four examples are educational exercises, not an estimate of practical corpus coverage or source-wide defect rates.
Dependency closure, independent tests, complete family/near-duplicate exclusions and source-use review remain open.
A candidate train partition does not establish training admission.
next_step: Pin expansion routes and measure eligible yield by language and practical role. Require explicit module/import/behavioral linkage and independent test oracles; prioritize library use, debugging and repository repair over more tiny algorithm exercises.

offline_replay.scope: Requires retained external artifacts and pinned project dependencies. Verifies input/source/tree/tokenizer/benchmark identities and reproduces linkage accounting and exclusions. Static review is not automated correctness approval.
